limits: Single symbol, single language (Python), single repository (agent-lab main checkout); the gap calls for a preregistered matched benchmark across at least two languages/repositories.
codebase-memory-mcp could not be included (removed from host 2026-09-21); only two of the three named tools (Serena, jCodeMunch) could be probed at all.

jCodeMunch's search_symbols and Serena's find_referencing_symbols are not the same operation (definition-name search vs. reference search), so the completeness numbers (0/3 vs 1/3) are suggestive, not a fair apples-to-apples recall comparison; a fair comparison needs jCodeMunch's reference-finding action (not identified/run in this bounded check) or Serena's find_symbol for the definition side.

No token-cost accounting was captured for the jCodeMunch call in this probe (the tool's compact output format was read directly rather than through a wrapper that records token counts), so the 'total cost' half of the gap's next_check is untested here.
No rg/LSP gold-set scoring across multiple tasks was attempted; this is one illustrative data point, not a scored benchmark run.
This check did not use Claude multi-agent fan-out or a long run; consistent with the shared-account reservation constraint.
